prompt:
Create one mascot logo for MISO. Exact text (copy verbatim, no other words): 'MISO'. Exact slogan: ''.
Render only the supplied exact text and nonempty slogan; the brand context is not additional lettering. Empty strings request no corresponding text.
Industry: cat treats. Audience: cat owners.
Styles: friendly compact cat mascot. Original brief palette context: Ink #263334 and warm orange #DF8747, Background: solid pure white #FFFFFF.
Avoid: unsolicited lettering, mockup scenes, watermarks, colored canvas, transparent background, external cast shadows. Use cases: Brand identity at 240px width and README previews.
Background: opaque. Produce a real PNG raster image. Use clean, readable shapes at small sizes; leave safe margins. Do not draw a transparency checkerboard, mockup, watermarks, or a concept grid.
Concept direction: Cat treats for discerning little companions: an original friendly cat-face mascot with broad cheeks, two strong ears, one asymmetrically closed eye and one curved cheek line that resembles a satisfied smile. Use a compact two-color ink and warm-orange silhouette, intentional white facial negative space, thick consistent curves and no fine whiskers. Put the exact text MISO directly beneath in a small but sturdy rounded custom uppercase wordmark, optically aligned to the cat. No paws, food packet, props, scene or other text.. Assumptions: Fictional demonstration brand; new concept approved for one sample by the user., All new showcase images must have a genuine opaque white background., Foreground palette is design intent, not exact-pixel certification..
Logo construction: Build a character mascot around the supplied subject and personality, with a compact identifiable silhouette and an intentional expression. Use style references for broad construction traits, not their brand words or traced signature shapes. The identity should remain recognizable in a one-color silhouette at the intended use size. This construction check does not replace the requested palette or request an extra monochrome image.
Lettering fidelity: preserve every Unicode character, capitalization, punctuation, space and reading order in the applicable text. Keep Hangul syllable blocks intact; do not translate, romanize, abbreviate or substitute lookalike glyphs. Shape changes must keep required text readable, including counters and joins at the intended size.
